description: Separate odometer disclosure statement made by the seller and acknowledged by the buyer when a motor vehicle changes hands: which vehicle, the odometer reading and the date it was read, the seller's certification of whether the reading is the actual mileage, and who the seller and buyer are.

issuing_state.description: State whose agency publishes the form, from the header, e.g. Florida.

form_number.description: Form number and revision printed in the footer, e.g. HSMV 82993 (REV. 11/11).

vehicle.description: The vehicle being sold, from the Vehicle Description table.

vin.description: Vehicle Identification Number exactly as printed, without spaces.

year.description: Model year as a four-digit integer. Ignore any thousands separator the form filler inserted, so '2,018' is 2018.

color.description: Vehicle colour, or null if the Color cell is blank.

body.description: Body style, e.g. Sedan, or null if blank.

title_number.description: Certificate of title number, or null if the Title Number cell is blank.

odometer.description: The odometer statement: the reading, the kind of odometer and when it was read.

reading_miles.description: Odometer reading in whole miles (no tenths), read from the digit boxes after NOW READS and joined into one number. Ignore the printed comma between the boxes, e.g. boxes 7 5 , 1 2 3 are 75123.

odometer_digits.description: 5 or 6, whichever DIGIT ODOMETER box is checked; null if neither is checked.

date_read.description: DATE READ, as an ISO date YYYY-MM-DD built from the month, day and year blanks.

enum: IS IN EXCESS OF ITS MECHANICAL LIMITS
mileage_certification.description: The ODOMETER READING statement whose box is checked, as printed without its number: REFLECTS ACTUAL MILEAGE (box 1), IS IN EXCESS OF ITS MECHANICAL LIMITS (box 2) or IS NOT THE ACTUAL MILEAGE (box 3, odometer discrepancy).

seller.description: The seller, from the first signature block.

state.description: State in the seller block, as printed.

zip.description: Zip in the seller block, as a string.

signed.description: True only if the Seller's Signature box contains a signature; false if it is empty.

buyer.description: The buyer, from the second signature block.

state.description: State in the buyer block, as printed.

zip.description: Zip in the buyer block, as a string.

signed.description: True only if the Buyer's Signature box contains a signature; false if it is empty.
